ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR. JUSTICE A.J.DESAI)
1. Present petition is filed with a prayer to quash and set aside the impugned award passed by the respondent No.1 only to the extent that the market value as determined under Section 26(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 has been multiplied with factor 1 (one) instead of 2 (two).
C/SCA/15941/2022 ORDER DATED: 19/04/2023 2.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Mr. Nirav Bhatt, learned advocate appearing for the petitioners would rely on an oral order dated 24.08.2021 in Special Civil Application Nos.11760/2021 and 10113/2021 passed on the basis of decision dated 12.09.2019 rendered by this Court in a group of petitions being Special Civil Application Nos.8734/2019 and allied matters.

In accordance therewith, the respondents are directed to decide the question whether the petitioners are entitled to Factor '2' being applied for Belim Abbasmiya Gulabmiya vs National Highway Authority Of India on 19 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44097009/
1 determination of their compensation and other benefits.

sentences.text: The Authority shall take a decision within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of the copy of the order and if the petitioners are entitled to the same, on such determination, the amounts shall be decided within period of three weeks thereafter.

If the petitioners moved for re-determination of compensation before the Arbitrator under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956, the petitioners may not insist for Factor '2' claim or in the alternative the respondents may be permitted to apprise the Arbitrator of the said issue so C/SCA/15941/2022 ORDER DATED: 19/04/2023 that there is no further multiplicity or complication in the proceedings.

3. We dispose of the present petition in the same terms in light of the judgment dated 12.09.2019 rendered by this Court in a group of petitions being Special Civil Application Nos.8734/2019 and allied matters.

ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR. JUSTICE A.J.DESAI)
1. Present petition is filed with a prayer to quash and set aside the impugned award passed by the respondent No.1 only to the extent that the market value as determined under Section 26(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 has been multiplied with factor 1 (one) instead of 2 (two).
C/SCA/15941/2022 ORDER DATED: 19/04/2023 2.
